string_var id
int op
ref animal
begin function {id,op}
let animal := StringToRef "$id"
if op == 0
SetFunctionValue (animal.IsInCombat)
elseif op == 1
SetFunctionValue (animal.GetDetected player)
elseif op == 2
SetFunctionValue (animal.GetPos X)
elseif op == 3
SetFunctionValue (animal.GetPos Y)
endif
end
